desc: Build a rooted adjacency list from edges with edge lengths; traverse via an explicit stack (no recursion) to handle n up to 5e4.
Maintain depth-indexed prefix-distance array, a dict last_prev_depth for each value, and the inherited lower bound during iterative DFS.
On entry: save old last_prev_depth[nums[v]], compute bound = max(inherited, prev+1), set last[nums[v]]=depth, write dist_at_depth.
Evaluate candidate length = dist - dist_at_depth[bound] and nodes = depth - bound + 1; update best pair (max length, then min nodes), initialized to [0,1].
On exit: restore last_prev_depth[nums[v]] to saved earlier value (via LIFO exit marker) for sibling consistency.
Verify examples and run a brute-force stress test on random small trees to confirm correctness; report results.
